purpose: Convert the v6 schema and fixture proof into a repeatable THOS phase-manifest authoring guide.
required_author_actions: Record phase_id, phase_type, Pacific/Auckland start time, local head, upstream head, and drift at phase start.
List only curated current-phase artifacts intended for publication.
List blocked actions explicitly, including GMUT validation boundary, cloud writes, broad cleanup, and old-agent spawning when applicable.
Record a validation chain that includes JSON parse, sensitive/path guard, whitespace check, curated staging, staged diff review, commit, push, and remote equality verification.
State thos_gmut_boundary.gmut_gates as open and thos_gmut_boundary.thos_claim as operational_scaffold_only unless exact closure artifacts exist.
author_must_not: Use THOS artifacts as physics validation.
Use Journey or Solas context as canon proof.
Hide drift, missing artifacts, missing sibling text, or blocked tool lanes.
Stage unprocessed traces, session captures, image captures, private auth material, or unrelated dirty worktree files.
Delete worktrees or broad-clean project data without separate approval.
copy_route: Start from v468A-thos-v7-x1-template-manifest-v1.json, update live heads and artifact list, then run both schema and Python publication validators.
